in_marathi.name: Ivansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ivansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Iva' which means 'God' and 'Ansh' which means 'Form'. The name Ivansh signifies the presence of Lord Shiva in a child. This name is believed to bring immense power, protection, and blessings to the child.
